boards.title: Startup detection and GUI failure recovery
normal: Missing feh produces actionable initial state
adverse: Failed GUI fallback preserves an actionable error
cases: Missing feh produces actionable initial state
Failed GUI fallback preserves an actionable error
boards.acceptance: Startup and fallback do not silently succeed or lose required dependency warnings.
boards.metric: Measure startup wall time and probe count separately from first-folder load.

boards.title: Startup folder and first-frame behavior
normal: No folder starts with Browse available
Valid start folder is loaded once
adverse: First-frame scan must not fight user drawer state
cases: No folder starts with Browse available
Valid start folder is loaded once
First-frame scan must not fight user drawer state
boards.acceptance: The startup hook is one-shot, invalid input is explained, and folder/scan state is consistent.
boards.metric: Count startup scans and first-frame work; do not add repeated filesystem probes.

boards.title: Shutdown and owned resource lifetime
normal: Close after preparation cleans only owned files
cases: Close after preparation cleans only owned files
boards.acceptance: No unrelated files/processes are removed; running readers and background writers have defined lifetime.
boards.metric: Measure residual processes, temporary files and memory after repeated open/close cycles.

boards.title: Window size, lock and persistence
normal: Resizable and locked modes honor bounds
adverse: Small viewport or changed display scale
cases: Resizable and locked modes honor bounds
Small viewport or changed display scale
boards.acceptance: Safe defaults and useful errors; runtime geometry matches persisted contract without resize loops.
boards.metric: Count configuration writes and viewport commands during idle frames.

boards.title: Launch-entry persistence and identity
boards.acceptance: Persistence neither drops unrelated entries nor confuses identity; failures do not masquerade as saved data.
boards.metric: Measure writes per edit and reload time with many entries; no per-frame writes.

boards.title: Action destinations and safe configuration writes
boards.acceptance: Preferences recover safely and cannot redirect actions silently to a stale or unintended location.
boards.metric: Check write frequency and blocking filesystem work on action selection.

boards.title: Native classification without pixel decoding
boards.acceptance: Listing classification follows its extension contract without decoding full images or claiming decodability.
boards.metric: Measure classification throughput on 1k and 10k metadata-only entries.

boards.title: Traversal, recursion and filesystem boundaries
boards.acceptance: Traversal follows declared recursion/symlink policy and returns usable results with accurate warnings.
boards.metric: Measure scaling with depth/file count and repeated metadata calls.

boards.title: Warning classification and bounded summaries
adverse: Tests running with privileges that bypass permissions
cases: Tests running with privileges that bypass permissions
boards.acceptance: Warning count/omission summary is accurate; permission tests prove the error actually occurred.
boards.metric: Measure warning allocation/log growth for error-heavy trees.

boards.title: External format probing, budget and cancellation
normal: Disabled probe makes no subprocess calls
adverse: All probes fail: attempted-call cap versus success count
cases: Disabled probe makes no subprocess calls
All probes fail: attempted-call cap versus success count
boards.acceptance: Record actual subprocess attempts, truncation and cancellation behavior; demonstrate any contract violation before fixing.
boards.metric: Count launches and bound probe latency; inspect whether the cap applies to attempted or successful probes.

boards.title: Network-path policy and expensive metadata
normal: Local path retains intended probe policy
cases: Local path retains intended probe policy
boards.acceptance: Policy and user-facing explanation agree; simulated path classification is not claimed as a real NAS test.
boards.metric: Count metadata/probe work and record a real-network requirement separately from deterministic tests.

boards.title: Superseded worker cancellation
boards.acceptance: Cancellation stops unnecessary work without suppressing the current scan; latency and limitations are evidenced.
boards.metric: Measure cancellation-to-last-work latency and surviving thread/process count.

boards.title: Partial/completion ordering and generation rejection
boards.acceptance: Deterministic event traces prove only valid updates apply and final list, inventory and scanning flag agree.
boards.metric: Measure full-list copying/coalescing cost and backlog growth under fast producers.

boards.title: Converted merge and live inventory preservation
boards.acceptance: No resurrection, lost mutation or downgrade; live inventory and revision invalidation reflect the merged list.
boards.metric: Measure merge complexity and inventory rebuild at large counts.

boards.title: Unified picker, Up and breadcrumb navigation
normal: Root breadcrumb stops at filesystem root
cases: Root breadcrumb stops at filesystem root
boards.acceptance: All entry points set folder/search/selection consistently and do not cause duplicate scans.
boards.metric: Measure navigation-to-first-result and redundant scan/subfolder requests.

boards.title: Asynchronous subfolder discovery
normal: Empty folder clears prior subfolder rows
cases: Empty folder clears prior subfolder rows
boards.acceptance: Stale generations cannot populate current navigation; pending state clears on all completion paths.
boards.metric: Measure requests per navigation and ensure render does not rewalk folders.

boards.title: Rescan selection and recursive-mode transitions
normal: Switch shallow to recursive and back
adverse: Pending viewer landing during active scan
Old tree folder after folder change
cases: Switch shallow to recursive and back
Pending viewer landing during active scan
Old tree folder after folder change
boards.acceptance: Selection uses documented precedence and never lands on an unrelated stale folder entry.
boards.metric: Measure rescan work and time to stable selection.

boards.title: Path-aware search filtering
boards.acceptance: Returned indices match the search contract and count; stale cached matches cannot leak across roots.
boards.metric: Measure 1k/10k filtering separately from sorting and GUI frames.

boards.title: Sort order and viewer-filelist parity
normal: Viewer order matches visible filtered order
cases: Viewer order matches visible filtered order
boards.acceptance: Order is reproducible and each list index remains associated with its correct path.
boards.metric: Measure sort-key allocations and sort time with duplicates and long paths.

boards.title: Memoization and mutation invalidation
boards.acceptance: Every mutation site is mapped to invalidation; cached and uncached reference results agree.
boards.metric: Measure cache hit/miss calls and copied bytes at 1k/10k; optimization requires measured benefit.

boards.title: Tree building, expansion and inventory counts
boards.acceptance: Visible rows, root counts and live inventory agree under filter and mutation sequences.
boards.metric: Measure tree construction and flattening; verify work is not repeated every idle frame.

boards.title: Selection, scrolling and row targeting
normal: Single click selects; explicit action opens
adverse: Pending scroll target not yet present
cases: Single click selects; explicit action opens
Pending scroll target not yet present
boards.acceptance: Actions target the clicked/selected contract and pending scroll is not consumed prematurely.
boards.metric: Measure click-to-stage and scroll-to-target latency.

boards.title: Flat/tree virtualization and long-row layout
normal: Long paths truncate with complete hover text
cases: Long paths truncate with complete hover text
boards.acceptance: Rendered rows and offsets stay consistent; accepted historical drift is measured rather than silently reopened.
boards.metric: Measure frame latency/row count while scrolling, resizing and expanding drawer.

boards.title: Inspector width and four-zone height budget
boards.acceptance: Height remains bounded and width reclamps on resize; no unbounded outer scrolling breaks virtualization.
boards.metric: Measure layout recalculation, font-measure calls and resize jitter.

boards.title: Drawer auto-expand state machine
normal: Rising edge opens once; falling edge retracts machine-owned sections
cases: Rising edge opens once; falling edge retracts machine-owned sections
boards.acceptance: All trigger/user transitions have asserted ownership and suppression behavior; no per-frame reopening.
boards.metric: Count state transitions and repaints rather than assuming animation cost.

boards.title: Section detach and reattach lifecycle
boards.acceptance: Deterministic IDs/order, no duplicate control owner, and closing does not lose unrelated section state.
boards.metric: Measure idle repaint and duplicate rendering with several detached sections.

boards.title: Pinned image context and safe action scope
normal: Pin remains on image while live selection changes
adverse: Pinned file disappears or belongs to another folder
cases: Pin remains on image while live selection changes
Pinned file disappears or belongs to another folder
boards.acceptance: Every enabled action acts on documented context; folder-scoped actions cannot silently target a different folder.
boards.metric: Check pinned validation for per-frame filesystem work and filter membership cost.

boards.title: Decode, dimension bounds and aspect correctness
boards.acceptance: Returned dimensions/buffer size/aspect are valid and unsupported input is explicit; uncommitted aspect_ratio helper is not assumed in baseline.
boards.metric: Measure decode wall time and peak allocation with real images, not fake JPEG names.

boards.title: Decode supersession and texture lifecycle
adverse: Rapid A-B-A selection with reordered completion
Folder change or moved file during decode
cases: Rapid A-B-A selection with reordered completion
Folder change or moved file during decode
boards.acceptance: Old completions cannot replace current stage; textures and worker state have bounded lifetime.
boards.metric: Measure input-to-visible-image latency and retained texture/memory across repeated selection.

boards.title: Stage empty/error state and action gating
normal: No selection shows intentional empty state
Stage remains image-only with status outside image
cases: No selection shows intentional empty state
Stage remains image-only with status outside image
boards.acceptance: Status and action availability agree with actual selection/decodability without stale-image actions.
boards.metric: Measure idle repaints and repeated error/decode retries.

boards.title: Filelist, spawn arguments and isolated profile
normal: Filtered sorted list starts at selected path
cases: Filtered sorted list starts at selected path
boards.acceptance: Argument vector and handoff quoting are safe, list encoding limitations explicit, and personal feh profile unchanged.
boards.metric: Measure filelist creation and launch-to-first-image separately.

boards.title: Launch entries, folders and multiple viewers
normal: Entry launches its own assigned folder
Launch all handles several entries independently
adverse: Entry folder differs from current browse folder
cases: Entry launches its own assigned folder
Launch all handles several entries independently
Entry folder differs from current browse folder
boards.acceptance: No dependence on current flat list; per-entry success/failure is accurate and does not suppress other entries.
boards.metric: Count per-frame folder stats and launch-time scans; count-cache deferral is not new-feature authorization.

boards.title: Handoff validation and deleted-image fallback
boards.acceptance: Only trusted surviving entries are accepted; rejected content cannot cause arbitrary file operations.
boards.metric: Measure validation work with large filelists and expensive canonicalization.

boards.title: Return selection, cross-folder landing and exit order
normal: Navigate in viewer then close and stage landed image
adverse: Two viewers exit in reversed order
cases: Navigate in viewer then close and stage landed image
Two viewers exit in reversed order
boards.acceptance: Exact GUI landing/scroll/stage behavior is demonstrated, not inferred from protocol-only tests.
boards.metric: Measure close-to-correct-stage latency and redundant rescans.

boards.title: Viewer child ownership and handoff cleanup
normal: Normal viewer exit cleans its handoff
cases: Normal viewer exit cleans its handoff
boards.acceptance: Cleanup does not remove a live peer session or unrelated file; child exit is observed without blocking UI.
boards.metric: Measure poll cost and stale-file accumulation over repeated viewer sessions.

boards.title: Save-copy destination and collision safety
boards.acceptance: Original bytes remain unchanged; existing unrelated destinations are not clobbered; failure leaves a defined state.
boards.metric: Measure copy overhead without treating safety checks as optional.

boards.title: Loss-proof moves and post-move selection
normal: Selected versus unselected source move updates correct row
adverse: User move while converted refresh arrives
cases: Selected versus unselected source move updates correct row
User move while converted refresh arrives
boards.acceptance: Source is removed only after verified success; partial outcomes are explicit; unrelated selection is not hijacked.
boards.metric: Measure filesystem branches separately; do not optimize away preservation checks.

boards.title: Output policies, backups and write boundaries
boards.acceptance: Each policy has explicit overwrite/backup/partial-write semantics and cannot silently violate original preservation.
boards.metric: Measure backup/write overhead separately from transforms; safety behavior is invariant.

boards.title: Context-menu action dispatch and outcomes
normal: Stage/flat/tree context menus dispatch same behavior
Cancel is not success or failure
cases: Stage/flat/tree context menus dispatch same behavior
Cancel is not success or failure
boards.acceptance: Target, produced path, error and inventory effects are consistent across every action entry point.
boards.metric: Measure synchronous action blocking and outcome-to-visible-state delay.

boards.title: Copy path, pixels and clipboard availability
normal: RGBA bytes/dimensions round-trip through isolated clipboard
adverse: Clipboard owner lifetime after function return
cases: RGBA bytes/dimensions round-trip through isolated clipboard
Clipboard owner lifetime after function return
boards.acceptance: Report actual execution separately from skip; no personal clipboard contents are overwritten during review.
boards.metric: Measure decode/clipboard blocking and peak memory with representative real images.

boards.title: Resize dimensions, fit and filter semantics
normal: Fit and filter selection match output geometry
cases: Fit and filter selection match output geometry
boards.acceptance: Decoded output dimensions and aspect match chosen semantics; invalid input cannot produce destructive output.
boards.metric: Measure decode/resize/encode phases and memory with identical images and build mode.

boards.title: Crop parsing, clamping and preview parity
normal: Preview pixels and saved crop agree
cases: Preview pixels and saved crop agree
boards.acceptance: Parsing and preview use the same coordinate semantics; invalid crops preserve original and show reason.
boards.metric: Measure preview regeneration frequency and crop latency.

boards.title: Encoding, conversion and external fallback
boards.acceptance: Output bytes, format, dimensions and reported destination agree; backend failure is explicit and preserves input.
boards.metric: Measure each backend separately and report optional-tool coverage honestly.

boards.title: Batch target snapshot, progress and cancellation
normal: Batch uses documented filtered target set
cases: Batch uses documented filtered target set
boards.acceptance: Input snapshot is explicit; cancellation and summary account for completed/failed/skipped work without corrupting outputs.
boards.metric: Measure progress cadence, cancellation latency and UI blocking.

boards.title: Rename token expansion and collision preview
normal: Deterministic input order and counter padding
cases: Deterministic input order and counter padding
boards.acceptance: Preview rejects invalid/colliding plans before writes and matches exact eventual target names.
boards.metric: Measure preview for 500 and larger lists without a per-frame filesystem scan.

boards.title: Rename execution and rollback safety
boards.acceptance: No unrelated file loss; partial and rollback outcomes identify exact remaining filesystem state.
boards.metric: Measure rename/rollback work separately; collision prevention must remain intact.

boards.title: Processed assets, summaries and inventory integration
boards.acceptance: List, inventory, status and cache invalidation describe actual produced assets without duplication or lost user changes.
boards.metric: Measure per-output versus batch refresh costs and redundant rebuilds.

boards.title: Cache readiness, configuration and disabled mode
normal: Valid isolated cache config becomes ready
cases: Valid isolated cache config becomes ready
boards.acceptance: Cache remains optional; readiness errors do not disable native tools or expose secrets.
boards.metric: Measure readiness probe frequency and avoid expensive checks on each frame.

boards.title: Cache identity, freshness and hit/miss correctness
normal: Changed operation parameters must not share result
adverse: Source bytes replaced at same path
cases: Changed operation parameters must not share result
Source bytes replaced at same path
boards.acceptance: A hit returns output equivalent to fresh processing of the intended source and parameters; actual hit is asserted.
boards.metric: Compare cold/warm runs with asserted hits and identical output validation, not only elapsed time.

boards.title: Cache-hit output policy and backup preservation
normal: Cache hit under safe new-file policy
adverse: Cache hit with in-place policy returns before backup branch
cases: Cache hit under safe new-file policy
Cache hit with in-place policy returns before backup branch
boards.acceptance: Controlled hit/miss reproductions establish backup and original-preservation behavior; suspicion alone is not a confirmed defect.
boards.metric: Measure only after safety parity is proven; no speed target can bypass backup.

boards.title: Precache jobs, progress and cancellation
normal: Precache snapshot completes with accurate count
cases: Precache snapshot completes with accurate count
boards.acceptance: Job terminates with accurate successful/failed/skipped accounting and does not modify originals.
boards.metric: Measure per-image overhead, progress cadence and cancellation latency.

boards.title: Prepare-fast materialization, launch and cleanup
normal: Real optimized files are usable and listed
adverse: Repeated prepare while viewer uses old files
cases: Real optimized files are usable and listed
Repeated prepare while viewer uses old files
boards.acceptance: Materialized outputs have unique correct identity and remain alive while consumers need them; originals unchanged.
boards.metric: Compare preparation plus first/subsequent view latency with raw path; report breakeven and peak disk/memory.

boards.title: Tool detection, recheck and mid-session loss
normal: Tool absent then present after recheck
adverse: Tool removed between detection and spawn
cases: Tool absent then present after recheck
Tool removed between detection and spawn
boards.acceptance: Capabilities and controls reflect actual conditions; arbitrary spawn failures are not mislabeled as missing tools.
boards.metric: Measure detection process count and latency; no repeated full detection on idle frames.

boards.title: Format routes and advertised processing capability
normal: Optional exotic route with external tool
cases: Optional exotic route with external tool
boards.acceptance: Discovery, stage decoding, processing and viewer support are distinguished accurately; unsupported claims become documentation findings.
boards.metric: Measure capability-render overhead and ensure route hints are not mistaken for benchmarks.

boards.title: Dependency guidance and format UI
adverse: Optional tool missing does not block core workflow
cases: Optional tool missing does not block core workflow
boards.acceptance: Hints, required/optional distinctions and enabled actions agree with runtime capability snapshot.
boards.metric: Measure expensive checks during rendering and duplicate guidance updates.

boards.title: Progress, status precedence and busy repaint
normal: Required dependency warning survives successful load
cases: Required dependency warning survives successful load
boards.acceptance: Status does not report stale success or permanent busy state; important errors remain actionable.
boards.metric: Measure idle/busy CPU, repaint cadence and status latency.

boards.title: Activity log retention, copy and error fidelity
boards.acceptance: Log stays bounded and useful without leaking secrets; copy checks run only with isolated clipboard.
boards.metric: Measure log churn and repeated joining cost under scan-warning load.

boards.title: Test isolation, fixtures and honest skip accounting
normal: Synthetic folders enable tests without personal libraries
cases: Synthetic folders enable tests without personal libraries
boards.acceptance: Produce executed/skipped/blocked inventory and an isolation recipe; do not run unsafe suites until prerequisites are satisfied.
boards.metric: Measure suite duration and flakiness by repeated isolated runs, not static test counts.

boards.title: Benchmark fixtures, provenance and process ownership
normal: Metadata and real-image fixtures are separate
adverse: Nonzero duration mistaken for similar timing
cases: Metadata and real-image fixtures are separate
Nonzero duration mistaken for similar timing
boards.acceptance: Define reproducible meaningful metrics and safe owned-PID capture; legacy scripts are reviewed before any execution.
boards.metric: Report repeated median/spread, build mode, hardware and cold/warm state; no invented universal speedup threshold.

boards.title: Build, CI and packaging verification
normal: Release binary and launcher use current build
cases: Release binary and launcher use current build
boards.acceptance: Separate baseline failures from regressions; no unrelated formatting rewrite or dependency upgrades to make gates appear green.
boards.metric: Measure build/release size only on matching revision/profile and report reproducibility limits.

boards.title: Requirement and source coverage reconciliation
normal: Each active entry point/helper has one primary board
adverse: README wallpaper claim lacks reachable spawn
Historical completed status conflicts with evidence
cases: Each active entry point/helper has one primary board
README wallpaper claim lacks reachable spawn
Historical completed status conflicts with evidence
boards.acceptance: Publish an auditable source-to-board/requirement/test matrix; uncovered code is explicitly assigned or excluded with reason, never silently ignored.
boards.metric: This is coverage reconciliation, not a performance task; count uncovered behaviors rather than lines alone.
